strongest_objection: The original journal ordering could expose an unrecorded current host/seed transition. Revised lines94-100 now make complete atomic journal publication precede Session/seed acceptance or display, including blocked advances, with bounded same-directory temp/rename and no unsupported fsync guarantee. This resolves the strongest objection.

resolved_objections.evidence: Design lines94-104 specify staged host output/seed, atomic whole-file publication before display/acceptance, previous valid file retained after partial temp writes,8MiB bound, no silent resume/repair and failed-attempt logging before retry.
Design lines83-89 require re-read/revalidate under per-key lock before generation; raced-in valid entry is a hit and valid bundles are never overwritten.

implementation_acceptance_checks: Inject journal failures after staging accepted replies and blocked-advance outputs; assert prior committed Session/seed and valid journal prefix survive unchanged.
Assert racing cache misses generate once and valid cache hits spend no AI slot; release acquired lock on each normal success/error path and keep crash-abandoned lock errors visible.
Define and test explicit counts/weight/text/signature/token/coefficient/seed limits with checked arithmetic.
Validate versioned journal records and sequence before replay extraction; malformed persisted data fails visibly.
Record seed/config/policy, both draws, source, complete bundle and known/unknown usage; text remains display-only.
remaining_material_limits: Generated prose factual accuracy is not established by structural validation.
Live account/model availability remains pending bounded authorised smoke; do not claim it proven before results.
Exact context signature deliberately trades reuse rate for correctness.
evidence: Read session.ail perception/ask/complete: Request.context contains only observer attributes/values/indicators, outgoing relationships and visible received evidence; host tick/revision and binding checks remain authoritative.
Read session.ail advanced: Blocked returns Output failed=true with retained earlier scheduler boundaries; caller must journal that candidate state before publishing it.
Read installed std/fs docs: renameFileResult atomically renames same-filesystem entries; appendFileResult returns Result but specifies no atomic-record/fsync guarantee.
Read installed std/ai docs: step returns Result[StepResult,AIError] and input/output/cache token usage; unknown failed-call usage cannot be inferred zero.
Read design-doc-creator skill: reject-by-default quorum strongest-objection and cost/banked-data trigger requirements apply.
satisfied_boundaries: Pure library has no authority or persistence.
Response weights are authored experiment coefficients; live model only produces text variants.
Exact context/policy/model/prompt signature prevents reuse across unseen or changed state.
AI attempts bounded, failures consume slots, no implicit retries/providers.
Model availability explicitly pending bounded live smoke, not claimed proven.
